title: Cadmies Adaptation
definition: The process of fine-tuning a language model to specialize its knowledge in the CADMIES knowledge base.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Training a language model on specific questions and answers related to CADMIES, allowing it to better understand and answer questions about CADMIES.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Adjusting the weights of a pre-trained language model to better match the data distribution of the CADMIES knowledge base.
difficulty_levels.expert: Applying a series of updates to a pre-trained language model to optimize its performance on the CADMIES dataset, with the goal of producing a model that demonstrates proficiency in understanding and generating responses related to the CADMIES knowledge base.

extra_fields.insight: The importance of fine-tuning in adapting a model to a specific domain, such as CADMIES, to achieve better performance.
